name: Keyword & Tag Extractor
description:
Pull the most important keywords and tags out of any web page in one click — handled privately on your device.

**How it works:** The page's text is read, a local AI model picks out the key terms, and the keywords are shown back to you.

**Setup:**
- Install and enable the awflow browser extension.
- Pick an on-device AI model the first time you run it.

**Good for:** writers and SEO-minded folks who want quick tags or topic keywords for any article.
setup: Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
